answer: Bind each identity to a zero-knowledge proof of a unique biometric template: the agent proves it controls one human body without revealing the template itself. A sybil farm needs a thousand distinct bodies, not a thousand keypairs, so its cost is recruiting real people, like carving a separate karst cave for every fake. Honest agents pass once and stand on a shared terrace of verified personhood, while puppets crowd a single jetty, all sharing one face. Limits: biometrics can be coerced or stolen, templates drift with age, and the scheme trusts the sensor that captured them.
